key_points: Q3 guidance missed estimates, causing short-term stock pressure (Sep 13).
Reported cap on employee AI usage weighing on sentiment.
Walmart's ad business highlighted as high‑margin contributor by Goldman Sachs.
Delivery network expanding via Papa John’s partnership and store‑based fulfillment.
Bank of America acquired ~65.8 M shares, indicating institutional confidence.
Dividend raised to $0.25 with payout ratio down to 31% in 2026.
Valuation remains rich (~34.7X forward) with higher costs limiting near‑term upside.
